patthana16.56:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasanidassanasappaṭigho nalokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… (saṃkhittaṃ). Hetuyā tīṇi… avigate tīṇi.
patthana16.56:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nalokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
